access.summary: Bear Brook State Park is state park land open to hunting under Res 7301.10, with one special rule: the game refuge area east of Podunk Road is bow and arrow only.
restrictions: East of Podunk Road (the game refuge): deer by bow and arrow only, and only with a valid archery license (Res 7301.10(c), RSA 212:14). No firearms or muzzleloaders there. Whether a crossbow counts as bow and arrow in the refuge isn't stated; ask Fish and Game. The map shows this area, drawn approximately.
No firearm discharge within 300 ft of occupied developed areas such as the campground, beaches and the archery ranges.
Portable tree stands only, Aug 1 - Jan 31, no nails or damage to trees. No permanent stands.
Baiting only by Fish and Game permit.
Heavily used by hikers, bikers and riders; expect company, especially on weekends.
